summary: fsgg.managed-group-contract/1 (eng/managed_group_owner.py, one stdlib file pinned by commit/path/sha256) is the supplier contract the Templates WASM caller binds at its Chromium support/runtime join (FS-GG/.github#4710 C-J1; Coordination #1046 under #1026). It is a sibling of eng/shared_process_owner.py, which contains by numeric process group and refuses detached groups/sessions; stock Playwright browser and Vite servers create such groups, and BCL Process sessions cannot observe re-parented descendants. Containment is a fresh leaf under an exclusive delegated cgroup v2 root; setsid/double-fork stays contained, and any process elsewhere in the root is an escape that fails the run. Birth is the unreaped child's pidfd plus start ticks and a /proc/<pid>/exe digest against profile leaderImages; the executable is hashed from an O_NOFOLLOW descriptor and exec'd through it; the leader gets no_new_privs. Signals go through pidfds whose start ticks and cgroup are re-checked after opening. Retirement runs in separately guarded stages: SIGTERM, grace, leaf cgroup.kill, then a sweep of the whole delegated root (cgroup.kill of member-created cgroups at any depth, quarantine-and-kill for processes in the root or supervisor cgroup, owner relocation if moved), reap, drain to EOF, bottom-up removal. Cleanup is classified from a final root census (residualInRoot); removal failure is reported, never hidden. Closed refusal codes precede launch. Lessons: independent review found that a single escape snapshot let fork-hopping, supervisor and nested escapees survive while the receipt claimed custody, and that one drain error could skip cgroup.kill; both are fixed with causal controls. Leaf limits are cooperative because members share the owner's uid; hard limits and supervisor-death cleanup belong to the unit (sudo systemd-run, Delegate=yes, User=runner, NoNewPrivileges=yes, KillMode=control-group, TimeoutStopSec short, TasksMax/MemoryMax). A unit with NoNewPrivileges=yes masks the owner's prctl, so that control runs without it. The local dev container cannot delegate a cgroup and the owner refuses there. Hosted compiler-and-tests at this revision: 9 refusal-level + 16 containment controls, owner-death control, 25/25 single-fragment mutants killed. Not established: hosted Templates runtime, browser support closure, the 27-case journey, publication or installed acceptance.
title: Managed-group candidate contract contains browser/process groups by delegated cgroup v2 with pidfd birth and root-wide retirement
